name: Tenshi no Gokigen Naname-dori
source:
In a country where various races live, you, a shinigami, have been ordered to attend a conference with angels.

To maintain good relations between angels and shinigamis, you must keep the polite angels happy.
Violating the angels' manners is considered disrespect! Make it through the conference safely and build the foundation for a good relationship!
